title: assign_devid_impl rollback heuristic documented in code but missing from header API
description: What is unclear: crypto2dev_assign_devid_impl() will call wc_CryptoCb_UnRegisterDevice if it decides it was the first caller (heuristic: prev_safe_mode == 0). The code comment explains this heuristic and its failure mode ('if the caller registered the device manually before calling assign_devid, that registration is also lost here'). But this warning is buried in the private implementation, not in the public header where wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() is declared. A user of the public API who reads only the header will call assign_devid() after manual registration and silently lose their registration on error. Fix: copy the key warning ('do not call if you have already called wc_CryptoCb_RegisterDevice for WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID') into the header comment on the public function.
